answer: TREM2+ microglia-like (TML) macrophages share an expression profile of P2RY12, CX3CR1 and OLFML3 with microglia-like macrophages from other developing organs, and also co-express immunomodulatory genes such as CX3CR1 (immune-inhibitory receptor) and SYT11 (regulator of IL-6 production).
